skillDispatch.boundary: Only compiled skill component IDs leave pending totals. Source-current environment-gated NeverTrigger IDs and unmatched source-disabled skills remain pending and are deferred until a real entry is present. Executable-pending means eligible for shared-contract work, not directly ready to bind. Mode activation, other skills, source operators and whole-enemy completion remain separate.

self-damage-maxhp.label: 按最大生命值周期自损

periodicAbilities.boundary: These are compiled complete periodic ability groups, not EnemySkill components. Reuse their stable group IDs without redispatching them; keep the 27-skill cohort, other source operators and whole-enemy gaps unchanged. Capability bindings overlap on the same enemies and are not additive enemy coverage.

nextSharedProvider.label: 技能触发与能力调度
nextSharedProvider.existingContractScope: Complete root passive Buff chains execute on blocked or HP condition edges. HP chains include all declared Buffs, attributes and output-damage listeners. Native predicates/parameters are known; namespace/target/attachment and FP tolerance use explicit inferences. Other mounted abilities, full enemy phases and original visual effects remain pending.
nextSharedProvider.instruction: 按已定位的技能、触发器和能力入口补共用调度接口；先闭合可追溯的一类调用合同。 优先从池内受影响记录闭合最底层共享合同；技能只推进executablePendingSkillIDs，deferredSkillIDs保留未完成，等真实环境入口后重新开放。复用alreadyBoundPeriodicGroups的完整公共组，不把它们算成新增EnemySkill或整敌完成。非池候选保留为后续复用，已接稳定ID不得重复派工。
nextSharedProvider.acceptance: 依赖影响人数不是本次可完成数量。按明确合同切片验证完整行为；不得把泛化调用定位当成一个已实现算子，不删除其他未完成能力。
